decisions.reason: The existing message-158 MODIFY already updates the About page prize copy to the revised Small and Big Block parameters.
The existing message-158 MODIFY already updates the Mission page prize-pool copy to the revised parameters.
The existing message-158 MODIFY fully captures the Big Block change to one $10,000 winner every 10,000 sales; no obsolete top-level key remains.
The existing message-158 MODIFY fully captures the Small Block change to one $500 winner every 100 sales; no obsolete top-level key remains.
Changing prize counts and draw intervals does not change the royalty amount, enforcement, ticket treatment, or continued funding of both prize pools.
The source changes prize sizes and draw intervals but leaves ticket issuance, separate counters, eligibility since the applicable prior draw, and post-draw reset rules unchanged.
The source expressly preserves the net prize amount per sales volume and does not change the mint price, founder allocation, referral commission, pool destinations, or residual allocation rule.
The no-referral recipient and reward components remain unchanged because both Small and Big Block tickets continue to exist.
The source retains both Small and Big Block mechanisms, so both ticket counters, permanent badges, and the referral-code metadata source remain valid unchanged.
The source changes winner counts and draw intervals but does not change ticket-weighted eligibility, Chainlink VRF, on-chain execution, or verifiability.
The revised prize parameters do not affect the Transak provider, fiat conversion, supported payment methods, buyer type, or wallet requirement.
The source does not change badge designs, referral milestones, storage, award basis, or current badge effects.
